question: Adrenaline stimulates the:

options.opa: Degradation of glycogen in skeletal muscle.
options.opb: Synthesis of glycogen in the liver.
options.opd: Synthesis of triacylglycerols in the liver.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Adrenaline -> Activation of glycogen phosphorylase in skeletal muscle -> Degradation of glycogen in skeletal muscle -> 95% CHAIN: Adrenaline -> Activation of adenylate cyclase -> Increase in cAMP levels -> Activation of protein kinase A -> Phosphorylation of enzymes -> Degradation of glycogen in skeletal muscle -> 90% CHAIN: Adrenaline -> Activation of hormone-sensitive lipase -> Lipolysis in adipose tissue -> 85% CHAIN: Adrenaline -> Stimulation of glucagon release -> Activation of glycogen phosphorylase in the liver -> Degradation of glycogen in the liver -> 95%
analysis: Adrenaline is known to stimulate the degradation of glycogen in skeletal muscle to release glucose for energy production during fight or flight response.
